ex.en: I rented a house with a garage.
ex.zh: 我租了一間附車庫的房子。

ex.en: He backed his car into the garage.
ex.zh: 他把車倒進車庫。

ex.en: The boys' bicycle is in the garage.
ex.zh: 男孩們的腳踏車在車庫裡。

ex.en: My car is at the garage for repairs.
ex.zh: 我的車在修車廠修理。

ex.en: The garage charged me too much for the new tires.
ex.zh: 修車廠的新輪胎收我太多錢了。

ex.en: Don't forget to take out the garbage.
ex.zh: 別忘了把垃圾拿出去倒。

ex.en: In our city, we carefully separate and collect garbage.
ex.zh: 在我們的城市，大家都會仔細做垃圾分類和回收。

ex.en: Throwing garbage on the street is not a good habit, remember?
ex.zh: 在街上亂丟垃圾不是好習慣，記得嗎？

ex.en: These garments are made of 100 percent wool.
ex.zh: 這些衣服是百分之百羊毛製的。

ex.en: The factory produces garments for export.
ex.zh: 這家工廠生產外銷成衣。

ex.en: Hang the garment up to keep it from wrinkling.
ex.zh: 把衣服掛起來，免得起皺。

ex.en: There is a good chance that gasoline prices will go up.
ex.zh: 油價很可能會上漲。

ex.en: The car ran out of gasoline on the highway.
ex.zh: 車子在高速公路上沒油了。

ex.en: Five gallons of regular, please.
ex.zh: 請加五加侖的普通汽油。

ex.en: The tank holds 15 gallons of gas.
ex.zh: 油箱可以裝十五加侖的汽油。

ex.en: The gardener planted a rose tree in the middle of the garden.
ex.zh: 園丁在花園中央種了一棵玫瑰。

ex.en: We hired a gardener to take care of the lawn.
ex.zh: 我們請了一位園丁來照顧草坪。

ex.en: Do you like to gamble?
ex.zh: 你喜歡賭博嗎？

ex.en: You don't like gambling, do you?
ex.zh: 你不喜歡賭博，對吧？

ex.en: Starting a business is always a gamble.
ex.zh: 創業總是一場冒險。

ex.en: The gamble paid off in the end.
ex.zh: 這場冒險最後成功了。

ex.en: The police arrested members of a local gang.
ex.zh: 警方逮捕了當地幫派的成員。

ex.en: He joined a gang when he was young.
ex.zh: 他年輕時加入了幫派。

ex.en: The whole gang is coming to my party.
ex.zh: 那群朋友全都會來我的派對。

ex.en: I went out with the gang from work.
ex.zh: 我跟公司那群同事出去玩。

gang.zh: gang up on：聯手對付、圍攻

ex.en: They always gang up on the new kid.
ex.zh: 他們總是聯手欺負新來的孩子。

ex.en: Don't gang up on me!
ex.zh: 別聯合起來對付我！

ex.en: The fuel gauge is broken.
ex.zh: 油表壞了。

ex.en: When did the fuel gauge stop working?
ex.zh: 油表是什麼時候壞的？

ex.en: It's hard to gauge how customers will react.
ex.zh: 很難判斷顧客會有什麼反應。

ex.en: We sent out a survey to gauge interest.
ex.zh: 我們發出問卷來了解大家的興趣。

ex.en: The baseball game was called off due to rain.
ex.zh: 棒球比賽因雨取消了。

ex.en: He is fond of watching baseball games on TV.
ex.zh: 他喜歡看電視轉播的棒球比賽。

ex.en: Whatever game I play with you, you never win.
ex.zh: 不管跟你玩什麼遊戲，你都贏不了。

ex.en: I don't have time to play games with you.
ex.zh: 我沒時間陪你玩遊戲。

ex.en: I need to buy a gaming laptop.
ex.zh: 我需要買一台電競筆電。

ex.en: The burglar gained access to the house through this door.
ex.zh: 竊賊是從這扇門進入屋內的。

ex.en: You gain nothing by speaking ill of others.
ex.zh: 說別人壞話，你什麼也得不到。

ex.en: She gained a lot of experience at her first job.
ex.zh: 她在第一份工作中累積了很多經驗。

ex.en: I gained three kilos during the holidays.
ex.zh: 我放假期間胖了三公斤。

ex.en: The stock gained 5% today.
ex.zh: 這檔股票今天上漲了 5%。

ex.en: The company reported a gain in profits.
ex.zh: 公司公布獲利增加。

ex.en: Weight gain is common in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天體重增加很常見。

ex.en: There is a garden in front of the house.
ex.zh: 房子前面有一座花園。

ex.en: This is the most beautiful flower in the garden.
ex.zh: 這是花園裡最漂亮的一朵花。

ex.en: We grow vegetables in our garden.
ex.zh: 我們在院子裡種菜。

ex.en: I would like you to assist me with my gardening.
ex.zh: 我想請你幫我整理花園。

ex.en: My grandmother loves to garden on weekends.
ex.zh: 我奶奶週末很喜歡整理花園。

ex.en: Tom puts gas in his car twice a week.
ex.zh: 湯姆每週幫車子加兩次油。

ex.en: Ten minutes later, our car ran out of gas.
ex.zh: 十分鐘後，我們的車就沒油了。

ex.en: Gas prices went up again this week.
ex.zh: 這週油價又漲了。

ex.en: As everyone knows, air is a mixture of gases.
ex.zh: 眾所周知，空氣是多種氣體的混合物。

ex.en: The explosion may have been caused by a gas leak.
ex.zh: 這場爆炸可能是瓦斯外洩造成的。

ex.en: Don't forget to turn off the gas.
ex.zh: 別忘了關瓦斯。

ex.en: A crowd of people gathered to see the parade.
ex.zh: 一大群人聚集起來看遊行。

ex.en: Everyone gathered together in the open space to meet.
ex.zh: 大家都在空地上集合開會。

ex.en: John kept gathering info.
ex.zh: 約翰持續收集資訊。

ex.en: We need to gather more data before we decide.
ex.zh: 做決定之前，我們需要收集更多資料。

ex.en: I gather that they'll agree with us.
ex.zh: 我猜他們會同意我們的看法。

ex.en: From what I gather, the meeting went well.
ex.zh: 據我所知，會議進行得很順利。

ex.en: Please mind the gap between the train and the platform.
ex.zh: 請小心月台與車廂之間的空隙。

ex.en: There's a gap in the fence.
ex.zh: 圍籬上有個缺口。

ex.en: The gap between them has narrowed.
ex.zh: 他們之間的差距已經縮小了。

ex.en: The gap between rich and poor is growing.
ex.zh: 貧富差距越來越大。

ex.en: Can you explain the gap in your resume?
ex.zh: 你能解釋一下履歷上的空白期嗎？

ex.en: She took a gap year before college.
ex.zh: 她上大學前休了一年空檔年。

ex.en: Gay marriage is permitted in less than 20% of countries.
ex.zh: 全世界不到 20% 的國家允許同性婚姻。

ex.en: His mother doesn't know he's gay.
ex.zh: 他媽媽不知道他是同性戀。

ex.en: I gazed at the sea for hours.
ex.zh: 我凝望大海好幾個小時。

ex.en: We gazed at the beautiful scenery.
ex.zh: 我們凝望著美麗的風景。

ex.en: I felt her gaze from behind.
ex.zh: 我感覺到她從背後投來的目光。

ex.en: She couldn't meet his gaze.
ex.zh: 她不敢直視他的目光。

ex.en: The streets were full of gaiety during the festival.
ex.zh: 節慶期間街上充滿歡樂的氣氛。

ex.en: Her gaiety lifted everyone's spirits.
ex.zh: 她的歡樂讓大家的精神都振奮起來。

ex.en: Spring in the north sends gales to sweep the roads.
ex.zh: 北方的春天颳起狂風，橫掃街道。

ex.en: The ferry was cancelled because of the gale.
ex.zh: 渡輪因為強風而停駛。

ex.en: The audience gasped when the magician disappeared.
ex.zh: 魔術師消失時，觀眾都倒抽一口氣。

ex.en: He came out of the water gasping for air.
ex.zh: 他從水裡出來，大口喘著氣。

ex.en: She gave a gasp of surprise when she opened the gift.
ex.zh: 她打開禮物時驚訝地倒抽一口氣。

ex.en: There were gasps from the crowd as the plane landed safely.
ex.zh: 飛機安全降落時，人群中傳來陣陣驚呼。

ex.en: This gadget tracks the temperature in the warehouse.
ex.zh: 這個小裝置會追蹤倉庫的溫度。

ex.en: He bought a useful gadget for his home office.
ex.zh: 他買了一個實用的小工具放在居家辦公室。

ex.en: The chef garnished the soup with fresh herbs.
ex.zh: 主廚在湯上撒了新鮮香草點綴。

ex.en: Garnish each plate with a slice of lemon.
ex.zh: 每個餐盤都放一片檸檬作為裝飾。

ex.en: The charity gala raised funds for a new community clinic.
ex.zh: 這場慈善晚會為新建社區診所募得款項。

ex.en: Guests wore formal attire to the annual gala.
ex.zh: 賓客穿著正式服裝出席年度盛會。

ex.en: The car is waiting at the gate.
ex.zh: 車在門口等著。

ex.en: It is time to shut the gate.
ex.zh: 該把大門關上了。

ex.en: Tom asked me to shut the gate.
ex.zh: 湯姆叫我把大門關上。

ex.en: Our flight now departs from Gate 12.
ex.zh: 我們的航班現在改從 12 號登機門出發。

ex.en: Please go to the gate at least 30 minutes before departure.
ex.zh: 請在起飛前至少 30 分鐘到登機門。

ex.en: They are often together, and go to the opera or visit art galleries.
ex.zh: 他們常常一起去聽歌劇或逛美術館。

ex.en: The gallery is showing works by local artists.
ex.zh: 這間美術館正在展出本地藝術家的作品。

garbled.zh: （聲音、訊息）斷斷續續、混亂不清的

ex.en: The connection was bad, and your message was garbled.
ex.zh: 訊號不好，你的訊息聽起來斷斷續續的。

ex.en: I received a garbled email full of strange symbols.
ex.zh: 我收到一封滿是奇怪符號的亂碼郵件。
